Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator

(m/f/d)

As a Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator (m/f/d) you will do the following:

Production planning

Draw up and monitor production plans

Develop capacity and resource plans including checking the availability of materials

Plan and coordinate production orders

Track production performance and proactively implement corrective actions in cases of deviation

Work closely with production, design and materials management

Compile key performance indicators and produce regular reports based on production data

Purchasing and Supplier Management

Create and process purchase orders and associated documents in BC

Obtain and verify order confirmations and monitor delivery times

Obtain quotations, compare prices and identify opportunities for cost savings

Optimise costs and procurement processes

Build and maintain professional relationships with suppliers

Data and process improvement

Ensure accurate and up-to-date master data in BC, e.g. products and suppliers

Improve workflows within planning and procurement

Contribute to new standards and continuous improvements across production and procurement

What you bring with you

You have a commercial or technical qualification, for example as an industrial technician, technical assistant, procurement officer or similar.

Experience in production planning, procurement or materials management within a manufacturing company is an advantage.

You have practical experience with EPR systems, preferably Microsoft Business Central and are keen to work actively with the system.

It is a plus if you have:

• Experience in production planning or procurement

• Strong Excel skills for data management, analysis and reporting

• Experience with key performance indicators and operational reporting

• Knowledge of Lean or other process improvement methods

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is a plus.

You do not need to be an expert in all these areas from day one. The most important thing is that you have an interest in production and supply chains, work systematically and take responsibility for seeing tasks through to completion.

**You also

**

• Build positive working relationships through clear and professional communication

• Demonstrate a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented working style

• Take initiative, contribute proactively, and collaborate effectively with others

• Stay organised and adapt priorities when circumstances change

• Use analytical thinking to identify and drive process improvements

**We offer you

**

• A dynamic position where your decisions make a real impact on operations and customer delivery

• A collaborative and supportive team environment with colleagues across Denmark and Germany

• The freedom to drive improvements and influence how we work with Business Central

• The chance to be part of an international company helping make offshore wind safer and more reliable worldwide

Welcome to Sabik Offshore A/S

We have been mastering the art of metalworking since 1888. With over 130 years of experience, we are committed to innovation and delivering exceptional solutions for our customers and partners. Our skilled team of 20 employees specializes in crafting high-quality components and structures from sheet metal and tubes in steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.

Combining traditional craftsmanship with a focus on flexibility and quality, we pride ourselves on exceeding customer expectations.

Sabik Offshore A/S is looking for a structured and committed Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator. The role combines production planning and procurement, acting as the link between production, design, materials management and our suppliers.

You’ll report to production management and join a team of 5–8 colleagues in Vejle who work in Microsoft Business Central (BC). BC will be your primary tool, and you’ll play an active role in both its day-to-day use and its further development – working closely with BC users at Sabik Offshore in Glostrup and Schwerin.

Sabik Offshore A/S is an international company in the offshore industry. In Vejle, we manufacture metal structures, including railing systems for offshore wind farms.

As a Production Planner & Supply Chain Coordinator you will be working at the forefront of an industry of the future. Are you ready?

to your future

please contact our HR Manager Wolfgang Schaper at +49 385 6767 0018 or jobs@sabik-offshore.com.

We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers an opportunity to develop beyond inspection readiness. You will work closely with the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and support selected functional initiatives, providing exposure to broader activities across the organization and our CMO and vendor network. In parallel, you will have the opportunity to build your GMP and clinical supply knowledge by learning and supporting selected operational activities related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

The position reports to the Director, Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing based in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing with selected functional initiatives and tasks across the organization.

• Support activities related to our external CMO and vendor network, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Build knowledge of GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and learn and support selected operational tasks related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible to be compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

Requirements

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GMP and GCP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including CMOs and vendors.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

The Team

You will be part of a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

Has this sparked your interest? Then we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter including your motivation for this position. We screen candidates on a continuous basis and call in for interviews.

Fully remote applicants will not be considered, so please indicate if you are willing to relocate if you’re not currently living in commute distance.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

What Makes Us, Us Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**You will be joining an innovative application development team within SimCorp's Product Division. We provide a cloud native SaaS product built on Azure using modern development principles, technologies and practices.

The product, Digital Engagement Platform (DEP) has been operational for over 5 years and based on client feedback and our own experience we have begun to lift the product to the next level, modernizing architecture and tech stack so we can scale DEP for a much larger audience than we can today.

This is why we need you - to help test and ensure the quality assurance of the new DEP 2.0 that we are building that can support the biggest clients, asset managers, across the globe.

The future success of our SaaS hinges on the ongoing enhancement of the application and the refinement of associated processes and tools. QA will continue be a vital element of this journey. While we have achieved remarkable milestones, there are still challenges to conquer.

Your contribution to the robustness of the DEP will be pivotal as we continually onboard new clients, ensuring high performance, top-notch security, and exceptional user experience for a diverse clientele.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As part of your role, you will collaborate with three agile development teams, each consisting of approximately 5-7 members. Your daily tasks will involve understanding and questioning customer requirements, discussing solutions, implementing automated tests for chosen solutions, some manual testing and providing support. The tools you will use are centered around .NET, Data Build Tool (dbt), TypeScript, and Microsoft Azure.

Our current and near future priorities include ensuring good maintainability, observability, high system performance, scalability, continuous integration, and deployment. Additionally, you will actively contribute to improving the product and its related processes within our modern cloud-based environment. Expect to leverage your current skills while also delving into and acquiring knowledge about cutting-edge technologies and testing methodologies in the cloud.

In addition to implementing customer features, we place a strong emphasis on continual improvement at every level: Across the entire company, within divisions, product areas, teams, and even at the individual level. Your everyday tasks will involve tackling issues such as how to streamline build and deployment durations, enhance collaboration, and increase the degree of test automation.

Overall, your contributions will spread across following primary areas:

Focus on test automation for the DEP product

• Automation of Testing in general

• Automate load and data ingestion from multiple sources

• Contribute to the test strategies

• Enhancement in Test Management and Processes (such as planning, structuring, tracking, coordinating releases, assessing etc.)

• Conducting Manual Tests (while there is still a need for some manual testing, your efforts will accelerate our progress, rendering it less required over time)

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

Testing

• TDD

• Agile testing

• Test methodologies (testing pyramid)

• Automated UI tests (Selenium/Cypress)

• Automated API based feature testing

• Data driven testing

• Automated Data testing

• C# and .NET development

• Microsoft Azure

• Continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)

• Writing and organizing cool testcases

• Manual application testing

Knowledge on the following technologies is considered a plus:

• XUnit / NUnit / RestSharp

• Moq

• Data Build Tool (dbt)

• AutoMapper

• FluentAssertions

• SpecFlow (BDD)

• JMeter

• Postman

• Azure Load Testing

• Azure DevOps

• Docker/Kubernetes

As a person, you value

• You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals.

• Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is.

• Clear communicator who speaks up when needed.

• Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset.

• Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork

• Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you

**Benefits

**

• Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.

• Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.

• Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Inclusive and diverse company culture

• Pension and health benefits and bonus

• Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace

• Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WE ARE

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Data Management Consultant

• Full-time

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

**System Architect (Principal) – Shape the Future of Medical Device Innovation

**Would you like to help drive the transformation from product-centric to platform-centric development in global innovate medtech company?

Then we offer you an opportunity to join a highly skilled R&D environment where collaboration, learning, and innovation go hand in hand. Your role will drive how we work with system architecture, requirements, modularization, and platform building across the organization – while contributing to products that make a difference for our users every day.

At Coloplast, we work every day to improve the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs. And you will play a key role in bringing our strategy to life by helping shape the future of how we develop innovative medical devices.

**Join a team shaping the future of R&D

**You will become part of our Requirements Engineering Team, which forms an essential part of our new Centre of Excellence in R&D, bringing together almost 500 talented colleagues.

In your new team, you will meet 7 colleagues who are global process owners of regulated medical device processes and our system architects driving our large strategic development projects.

Together, we define and improve ways of working across R&D to enable ambitious innovation to reach our users faster through a more structured and scalable development approach.

And of course, we make sure to have fun along the way.

**Lead the development of the System Architecture discipline

**As our new Principal System Architect, you will lead the development of the system architecture discipline and help position it for the future. This means you will lead Coloplast’s journey from developing individual products towards platform building and building up competences within system architecture discipline.

Specifically, you will:

• Lead and support the implementation of platform-based product development and manufacturing process development.

• Strengthen and mature the system architecture discipline by defining and evolving processes, methods, and best practices.

• Contribute to building system architecture capabilities across the organisation through training, sparring, coaching and knowledge sharing.

• Shape and communicate the value of system architecture as part of ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Build alignment across stakeholders in a complex, cross-functional environment by engaging, listening, and creating shared understanding.

• Driving results through colleagues, including other system architects, project managers, program managers and system engineers, in a motivating and engaging way.

• Contribute hands-on to development projects as a trusted architecture resource, working closely with teams to define and deliver system architecture artefacts (e.g. system design, interface specifications, functional analysis and impact analysis)

• Translate inputs from across the business (e.g. commercial, regulatory, manufacturing) into clear and usable system architecture decision and artefacts, ensuring different perspectives are reflected

• Ensure system architecture is effectively integrated with related development disciplines such as requirements engineering, test, and documentation management

**Solid Experience In System Architecture For Physical Product Development

**You are a team player, with strong communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly and concisely as you manage stakeholders across a complex and large organization. Moreover, you have the ability to balance and consider cross-functional concerns in decision-making, and you take a coaching leadership approach to support and develop colleagues and stakeholders.

While experience from the medical device industry is valuable, we also welcome candidates with a strong systems engineering and architecture background from other complex product development industries such as aerospace, defense, industrial automation, robotics, windmill industry or advanced consumer products.

**What We Expect From You

**

• 7+ years of experience in system architecture, preferably for physical products and hardware-based systems, not solely software.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and a proven ability to drive alignment across functions, disciplines, and organizational levels.

• Comfortable working across engineering, product management, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and other key functions.

• Experience leading or influencing organizational change, including the implementation of new ways of working, processes, or engineering practices.

• Ability to provide technical leadership, coaching, and architectural guidance to teams and stakeholders.

• Extensive hands-on experience with systems engineering for complex products, including system architecture, requirements management, interface management, verification, and validation.

• Proven experience establishing, evolving, and governing system architecture and systems engineering practices.

• Experience with modular architecture, product platforms, and reusable architecture strategies.

• Strong knowledge and practical application of systems engineering principles, methods, and best practices, including recognized industry frameworks such as INCOSE.

• Experience contributing directly to development projects and delivering architecture artefacts from concept through implementation.

• Proven experience operating in regulated product development environments and balancing technical, quality, risk, regulatory, and design control requirements.

• Ability to translate diverse business, user, and technical needs into clear architecture decisions and system-level solutions.

• Strong architectural judgement and ability to balance commercial, technical, regulatory, manufacturing, and user considerations.

• Experience defining system boundaries, interfaces, and reusable architectural building blocks that support platform-based product development.

• Motivated by both shaping long-term architectural direction and contributing to successful day-to-day product delivery.

**You might also bring

**

• Experience from medical device development or other highly regulated industries.

• Knowledge of relevant standards and frameworks such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, or equivalent.

• Understanding manufacturing, industrialization, and production processes, ensuring architectures are scalable, manufacturable, testable, and cost-effective throughout the product lifecycle.

• Experience supporting product strategy through platform thinking, technology roadmaps, and long-term architecture planning.

Please note: Seniority level will be determined based on your experience (principal, senior principal)

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Head of Requirement Engineering, Centre of Excellence, R&D, Stine Renberg at +45 49113320. We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you'll lead our Strategy Execution and Projects team and help strengthen the enterprise-wide deployment of Ørsted's highest strategic priorities. You'll combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, partnering closely with senior leaders to translate strategic ambitions into actionable programmes and projects that create lasting business impact across the organisation.

**Welcome to Strategy Execution and Transformation

**You'll be part of Strategy Execution and Transformation, where you'll join a team of experienced strategy, transformation, and consulting professionals responsible for supporting the development, deployment, and execution of Ørsted's strategy. The department is part of Strategy, Innovation and Transformation and works closely with colleagues across Group Strategy, Portfolio Management, Innovation, Finance, People & Culture, Communications.

As Head of Strategy Execution and Projects, you'll lead a team responsible for driving strategy deployment across Ørsted and delivering strategic initiatives that support our long-term ambitions. You'll also play an active role in the leadership team of Strategy Execution and Transformation, helping shape priorities, strengthen collaboration across teams, and foster an inclusive, high-performing culture aligned with Ørsted's leadership promises.

**You'll play an important role in:

**

• leading, developing, and empowering a high-performing team while building core capabilities and fostering a collaborative culture

• owning and continuously improving the annual strategy cycle, ensuring effective collaboration across Strategy, Finance, People & Culture, Communications, and the business areas

• ensuring that Ørsted's highest strategic priorities are translated into clear multi-year business plans, objectives, and execution roadmaps

• partnering with senior stakeholders across the organisation to identify, prioritise, and deliver strategic initiatives with measurable business impact

• providing strategic guidance on business cases, strategic assessments, implementation planning, and value realisation

• leading selected enterprise-critical projects and initiatives to secure successful outcomes and sustainable results.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a strong track record of leading, developing, and motivating high-performing teams

• bring significant experience from strategy consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, or a similar strategic leadership environment

• demonstrate strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and analytical capabilities, enabling you to translate complexity into clear recommendations and actions

• build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across functions and business areas

• communicate clearly and confidently, adapting your message to different audiences and influencing decision-making at executive level

• hold a master’s degree within business, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience from the energy or renewable industry is beneficial but not required.

**Shape the future with us

Private markets are being transformed — and you could be at the center of it.

**The gap between institutional grade private market tools and the technology that powers them has never been bigger. Trillions of dollars flow through private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real assets, yet the software managing this capital often lags a decade behind. SimCorp is changing that.

We're a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to modernize the private market ecosystem for institutional investors with cross-asset portfolios. We're scaling fast, our customers are the best in the world, and we're looking for a world-class Product Manager to help us build what comes next.

**If you understand the nuances of Private Markets, have a deep empathy for the professionals navigating this space, and know how to turn complexity into elegant software, we need to talk.

****WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a key component of product management for Private Markets, you will own the product strategy and execution alongside our engineering team. You will sit at the intersection of finance and technology translating the intricate workflows of private market professionals into intuitive, powerful software that delights users and drives business outcomes.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll work directly with the leadership, clients, market participants, engineering, sales and go-to-market teams, and you'll have real ownership over a product area that is central to our company's growth. You will shape the roadmap, define priorities, and rally a talented team of engineers and designers around a shared vision.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Orchestrate high-stakes product demonstrations, executive roundtables, and client conferences to evangelize the solution and secure stakeholder buy-in across diverse audiences.

• Define, own and evolve the product roadmap for our private markets platform, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term strategic vision.

• Be the primary point of contact, the go-to person for private markets and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategically own, manage and prioritize the product backlog in lockstep with Leadership, balancing technical debt with high-value strategic investments to ensure seamless delivery.

• Deeply immerse yourself in the workflows of private markets - conducting interviews, shadowing users, and synthesizing feedback into actionable insights.

• Write crisp, well-reasoned product specifications and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship high-quality features on time.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to author comprehensive user features and stories, establishing rigorous acceptance criteria to ensure all deliverables meet 'Definition of Ready' and 'Definition of Done' standards in the acceptance of deliverables.

• Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate outcomes, iterate quickly, and communicate results to stakeholders.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand market gaps, competitive dynamics, and the evolving needs of our customer base.

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI and automation into core workflows — making complex workflows faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and the 'why' behind every decision.

• Stay ahead of regulatory developments, market trends, and competitive shifts in the private markets technology landscape.

• Represent the voice of the customer in every product decision — advocating relentlessly for user experience without sacrificing business viability.

**Who You Are

**You're not just a product manager, you're a private market expert who happens to love building software. You've spent time in or around private markets and you feel the pain points firsthand. You're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you see a workflow for the first time and immediately start mentally redesigning it. You are rigorous in your thinking, persuasive in your communication, and relentless in your follow-through.

You thrive in ambiguity. You can take a messy problem, break it down into its component parts, and build consensus around a path forward without needing every answer handed to you. You care about craft: a half-built feature or a confusing UX genuinely bothers you. And you're a collaborator at heart, you know that great products are built by great teams, and you know how to bring out the best in the people around you.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years product management experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS or fintech.

• Meaningful exposure to private markets, whether through prior work at a PE firm, fund administrator, placement agent, LP, or financial software company serving these markets.

• Demonstrated track record of successfully launching products and features that users love and that drive measurable business results.

• Strong understanding of private asset structures, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, and related workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can write a tight one-pager and present to a room of skeptical executives with equal confidence and are not afraid to use AI.

• Proficiency in working with data: you're comfortable analyzing usage metrics and building dashboards to support your decisions.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams in an agile environment; familiarity with modern development practices is a plus.

• High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly with customers, engineers, and senior leadership alike.

• A genuine curiosity about technology and its role in reshaping financial services.

• Experience engaging proactively with clients and stakeholders to solicit input for user stories.

• Broad knowledge of the Alternative Investment marketplace and system vendors.

• Experience with SimCorp Dimension® (advantageous but not required).

• Proven track record in roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, Engineering, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Consultant within software development.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills focused on business outcomes and complete product offers.

• Ability to encourage, motivate, and influence teams and peers; contribute to improvements across the community.

• Understanding of how great products are built and deliver value to clients.

• Creative and inquisitive mindset with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Degree in Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or a related field (preferred).

**Why Join Us

**

• Meaningful ownership — your decisions will shape a platform used by some of the world’s most sophisticated investors, and your work will have visible, lasting impact.

• A culture built on trust, autonomy, and deep collaboration.

• A leadership team with deep domain expertise, proven execution experience, and a genuine commitment to building an exceptional, humancentered culture.

• The opportunity to build category defining technology in a space undergoing massive transformation where your influence won’t just move the product forward, it will help reshape an entire industry.

• A place where craft matters, ideas win on merit, and people are encouraged to think boldly, act decisively, and do the best work of their careers.

**NEXT STEPS

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. Scientific Software Engineer for Research Software Engineering Group

The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of Europe’s largest research infrastructure projects and is building the world’s most powerful neutron source. Through cutting-edge science and technology, ESS will enable discoveries that advance our understanding of materials, energy, health, and the environment.

About the role

The Research Software Engineering (RSE) group develops and maintains critical software systems that make neutron scattering experiments at ESS possible and successful.

As a Scientific Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of key platforms supporting the scientific user journey, including the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information systems. You will work closely with scientists, software engineers, and stakeholders across ESS to gather requirements, understand user needs, and develop robust software solutions that integrate seamlessly with the wider ESS ecosystem.

The RSE group uses modern web technologies and software engineering practices to deliver high-quality software with a long operational lifetime. In addition, the group is expanding its focus on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that can enhance the scientific user experience. As part of this effort, you will contribute to new AI-related initiatives and help establish RSE as a centre of expertise and development for AI applications within the Science Directorate.

This position is well suited for an experienced software engineer with a strong technical foundation, excellent collaboration skills, and a passion for building software that enables world-class scientific research.

Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain software systems supporting the scientific user journey at ESS.

• Contribute to the development of the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information management systems.

• Gather, analyse, and refine requirements from scientific and technical stakeholders across ESS.

• Design and implement integrations between RSE applications and other ESS services and platforms.

• Apply modern software engineering practices to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions.

• Contribute to technical and process improvements within the SIMS group.

• Participate in AI and Machine Learning initiatives supporting the Science Directorate.

• Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and international partners to develop innovative solutions for scientific computing and data management.

• Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the team when appropriate.

• Contribute to software architecture discussions and technology decisions within the group.

Required qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Typically 4-7 years of relevant professional experience in software development.

• Experience developing modern web applications and services.

• Strong programming skills and experience with modern software development practices.

• Experience gathering requirements and working directly with stakeholders and end users.

• Experience designing and implementing integrations between complex software systems.

• Ability to work independently and manage technical tasks and projects with limited supervision.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable qualifications

• Experience working with scientific software, research infrastructures, or data-intensive environments.

• Experience with cloud-based services and distributed systems.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies and their practical application.

• Experience with user-facing platforms, portals, or information management systems.

• Familiarity with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and container technologies.

• Experience working in international and multidisciplinary environments.

• Experience contributing to open-source software projects.

What we offer

DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.

You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer flexible working conditions, opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large-scale experiments.

Benefits include 25 + 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.

This is a full-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.
